subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: If the reporter confirms vLLM token usage is present but cost is blank or zero, should OpenClaw treat local vLLM models without positive pricing as token-only, warn as unknown-cost, or require explicit local pricing before cost appears?
rationale: Current source and docs already support token capture and explicit local pricing; changing the cost behavior without a maintainer-approved contract risks confusing intentional zero-cost local deployments with unknown paid usage.

options.title: Keep evidence-first, route cost-only gaps to unknown pricing
options.body: Ask for the raw stream and Usage API payloads first, then handle confirmed cost-only gaps through the unknown-pricing contract tracked in the related issue.

options.title: Document token-only vLLM as intended
options.body: If maintainers want local zero-price models to remain token-only unless pricing is configured, this issue should become a docs/setup clarification after evidence confirms tokens are present.

options.title: Add an unknown-cost warning contract
options.body: If maintainers want token-burning zero-priced local models to be visibly suspicious, define and test the warning or marker behavior before queueing a fix.

recommendation.title: Keep evidence-first, route cost-only gaps to unknown pricing
recommendation.body: Ask for the raw stream and Usage API payloads first, then handle confirmed cost-only gaps through the unknown-pricing contract tracked in the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the cost-accounting history and the related unknown-pricing mitigation.
